episodes.title: The Rumor
episodes.summary: Gwan-seok, skilled at finding money, joins Hee-dong to pursue rumours of a sunken treasure. The two set off in pursuit of a potential fortune.

episodes.title: Bring in the Pros
episodes.summary: Gwan-seok and Hee-dong reach Mok-po, facing a rough welcome from Captain Hwang and Beol-gu's gang before they search for the shipwreck's exact location.

episodes.title: Outlaws of the Sea
episodes.summary: The location is still unknown when a rival shows, adding to the race. Chairman Cheon wavers, forcing Gwan-seok to scheme to get him back on board.

episodes.title: Feast with the Enemy
episodes.summary: Gwan-seok and Hee-dong partner with Professor Kim's crew and set sail. Meanwhile, Chairman Cheon bribes an assemblyman with pottery for favours.

episodes.title: Pro Wrestler
episodes.summary: Jung-sook and Deok-san reach Mok-po; she assesses pottery, he seeks Professor Kim. Convinced of the pottery's value, the team makes their first dive.

episodes.title: The Plunge
episodes.summary: The team hires more divers, making their first real haul. Gwanseok takes a secret job; Jungsook auctions shipwreck treasure at a U.S. military base.

episodes.title: The First Casualty
episodes.summary: Chairman Cheon makes a big error and Jungsook jumps to control the company. At the salvage site, an accident occurs and it is Heedong's turn to dive.

episodes.title: The Sunken Ship
episodes.summary: The ship rises from the deep, pottery in tow in front of Heedong. Men seize Professor Kim; Heedong, eyeing profit, dreams of a grand public salvage.

episodes.title: Flip-Flop
episodes.summary: Under a false government banner, the salvage begins. As Honggi probes the diver's accident, danger near. He gives Heedong key information to survives.

episodes.title: A Hell of a Mess
episodes.summary: Professor Kim flees to Busan with the loot, with Honggi in pursuit. In Seoul, Gwanseok takes on a task. Heedong and Seonja reach warehouse in Muan.

episodes.title: The Last Order
episodes.summary: Sensing trouble, Gwanseok rushes to Muan. After Professor Kim's boat sinks, Gwanseok, Heedong, Jungsook and others fight over the remaining treasure.
